item.title: Vans' Luckiest (& Most Luxe) Skate Shoes Have Delicious Dior Flavor
item.description: What came first: the Vans OTW Authentic Clover or the Dior Saltwind Sneaker? Well, that’s tricky to answer.

item.title: This Suave adidas Dress Shoe Is Literally an Espresso Sunrise
item.description: CLOT's adidas Superstar Dress sneaker is a juiced-up mix between fashion's favorite sneaker & a wedding-ready dress shoe.

item.title: This Nike ACG Is Lighter Than Your Lightest Jacket, Warmer Than Your Puffiest Puffer
item.description: The Nike ACG "Lava Loft" is a trail-tested lightweight jacket that looks as good on mountain climbers as it does on the annoyingly cool dwellers of downtown.

item.title: Nike's Waterproof Boot Is Like a Timberland Trek Sneaker
item.description: "If it ain't broke, don't fix it" is a mantra that seems to apply across brands even. Nike gave a Timberland classic a spin and there's no denying: It slaps!

item.title: Samuel L. Jackson Bends Reality for the Latest adidas Originals Campaign
item.description: Tapping culture’s leading man to head up a “superstar” cast, the iconic trefoil logo arrives with an ode to those who define the now and whose impact will last a lifetime.

item.title: Why Are Mall Brands Making “Custom” Clothes?
item.description: From Bad Bunny’s Zara Super Bowl outfit to Sydney Sweeney’s “custom” American Eagle dress, fast-fashion brands are getting in on bespoke. But who is it really for?

item.title: Even Skate Brands Are Turning out Dapper Walking Shoes
item.description: The Last Resort AB General Model 001 is the brand’s first real step outside of its comfort zone. The skaters have created a handsome walking shoe.

item.title: A Margiela Nerd Documented a Margiela Nerd's Dream Archive
item.description: 0 0 10, a 720-page book by printings.jp on Maison Martin Margiela, focuses exclusively on the revolutionary designer's revolutionary clothes.

item.title: These are the Rolls-Royce of Motocross Goggles
item.description: The eyewear artisans at Jacques Marie Mage have gone to great lengths to create luxurious motocross goggles. But they haven't made many of them.
